separate_defect_found_in_the_same_window.root_cause: bridge/autoplay.py treated any unrecognised card_select class name as combat-owned, but an out-of-combat grid has no combat owner to hand it to, so the abstention was a deadlock
separate_defect_found_in_the_same_window.real_build_evidence: MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.AutoSlay.Handlers.Screens/DeckEnchantScreenHandler.cs drives NDeckEnchantSelectScreen, so the build's own auto-player considers it out of combat; NCombatPileCardSelectScreen has no handler in that registry
separate_defect_found_in_the_same_window.fix: abstain only on the one class the registry does not drive, and walk distinct grid indices until the screen's own can_confirm lights up (recorded by tests/test_autoplay.py)
